subject: design-technology
title: Construction Techniques
welcome_lead: Sewing, weaving and knitting — building fabric.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: weaving, knitting, sewing, seams.

walkthroughs.body_html: In weaving, warp threads run lengthwise on the loom. The weft is woven over and under them. Most shirt and bedding fabric is plain woven.
Knitting links yarn loops. The result stretches — that's why jumpers are knitted, not woven. T-shirts are also knitted (jersey).
A seam joins two pieces of fabric. A hem is the folded finished edge. Use a sewing machine for speed and strength, or hand-stitch for control.
